purpose: Convert repeated mission feedback into bounded evidence for role creation, reuse, secondment, merge or prune decisions.
principle: Prefer reuse, secondment, training or tool/resource repair before creating a permanent new role.

recurrence.description: Same unmet capability appears across distinct tasks/missions.

blocked_missions.description: Number/severity of mission gates blocked by the missing capability.

crew_wait_pressure.description: Measured crew wait or queue loss attributable to the gap.

rex_recurrence.description: Repeated REX events lack an effective role owner.

special_habitat.description: Capability requires a distinct licensed/tool/runtime habitat.

independence_boundary.description: Verification/authority separation cannot be safely combined with existing owner.

pca_bt_cluster.description: Measured PCA/BT shows a persistent workload/intervention cluster.

existing_role_overlap.description: Existing role can cover the need with bounded training/secondment.

one_off_need.description: Need is isolated or unlikely to recur.

tool_or_resource_only.description: The gap is better repaired by tool/resource availability than role creation.

normalization: All signal and penalty inputs are normalized to 0..1 before scoring.
anti_proliferation_rules: Do not create a new permanent role for a single task.
Do not create a role solely because an existing crew member is overloaded; test reallocation/resource repair first.
Do not duplicate a KEB, DOW, QA, Governor or child authority boundary under a new title.
Conceptual and trial roles cannot promote engineering/compliance truth.
A successful trial defaults to PARTIAL, not CONTROL_ELIGIBLE.
If evidence shows strong overlap with an existing role, merge the competency into that role and retire the candidate role ID.
